en.headline: Minister to review stray-dog feeding rules and abandonment penalties
en.dek: Environment chief Tse Chin-wan told lawmakers three of five dogs caught after the Yuen Long fatality were microchipped, and said owners cannot simply abandon animals.
body: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan told a Legislative Council policy briefing on Wednesday that the government would review the regulation of feeding stray dogs and related enforcement, after a woman was suspected to have been attacked and later died in Yuen Long.

Of the first three dogs captured, two were microchipped; of two more taken in a later sweep, one was chipped, Mr Tse said, according to RTHK. He said that showed owners had a duty not to abandon animals at will, and that forthcoming legislative amendments would consider whether penalties for abandonment should be tightened, with a further report to the Legislative Council expected by the end of the year.

Responding to legislator Steven Ho, Mr Tse said the case showed feeding and enforcement work still needed improvement on several fronts. He repeated that the number of stray dogs caught had fallen from about 11,000 in 2002 to about 400 a year now.

Asked by legislator Chan Chun-ying whether the death would affect a scheme allowing dogs into restaurants, Mr Tse said the Yuen Long case involved unattended animals, whereas dogs entering restaurants are accompanied and must be kept under control. He said the first phase of the dining scheme, with 1,000 places, was essentially fully subscribed.

zh.headline: 謝展寰：將檢視饋飼流浪狗及執法 考慮加強棄養罰則
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長在立法會簡報會表示，元朗事件後捕獲五隻狗當中三隻有晶片，反映狗主不能隨便棄養，年底前回立法會交代修例。
body: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰周三在立法會相關政策簡報會表示，政府一向重視流浪狗問題，對元朗有人懷疑被狗隻襲擊後死亡感到傷痛，會檢視加強監管，包括饋飼流浪狗及執法工作。
他向港台表示，第一批捕捉到的三隻狗當中兩隻有晶片，第二批兩隻當中一隻有晶片，反映狗主有責任，不能隨便棄養。當局日後修例會檢視是否需要加強棄養懲罰，預計年底再向立法會交代修例工作。
回應議員何俊賢時，謝展寰說今次案件反映相關工作仍要多方面改善。他重申，2002年當局捕捉到約1萬1000多隻流浪狗，現時每年約400隻，情況已有改善。
議員陳振英問及事件會否影響狗隻准許入食肆的措施。謝展寰說案件涉及無人看管的流浪狗，入食肆的狗隻有人帶領，狗主須妥善約束，兩者並無衝突。他指第一期措施一千個名額基本上滿額。
